category_reasoning: Domain and/or use case matches Annex III high-risk areas.

design: Personal data processed; GDPR alignment and DPIA may be required.
training: Dataset representativeness uncertain; potential performance disparity across subgroups.
validation: Bias and fairness not evaluated; potential discriminatory outcomes.
post_market: Model drift and data shifts may degrade performance over time.

recommended_measures.name: Conduct bias and fairness evaluation
recommended_measures.description: Assess disparate impact across protected attributes; document metrics and remediation.

recommended_measures.name: Improve dataset representativeness
recommended_measures.description: Augment datasets to cover relevant demographics and contexts; document provenance.

recommended_measures.name: Establish risk management system
recommended_measures.description: Documented, continuous process covering identification, analysis, mitigation, and monitoring.

recommended_measures.name: Maintain technical documentation
recommended_measures.description: Comprehensive documentation of system, datasets, tests, and controls.

recommended_measures.name: Data minimization and DPIA
recommended_measures.description: Conduct DPIA and minimize retention of PII
